name: drag-items
title: Draggable Reorder List
description: A narrow stack of white task cards, each with a title, a line of detail, a due date, a black Open task button and a nine-dot grip on the right. Dragging a grip lifts its card while the rest slide aside to make room.
use: A short task or issue list needs manual reordering by dragging rather than by a sort menu.
avoid: Only the small grip starts a drag, the order never persists, and the list is capped at a narrow column.
a11y: The grip is a button labelled Reorder, but only pointer drag reorders, so there is no keyboard path and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three white rounded task cards stacked with small gaps on a black page. Each shows a bold title, a faint subtitle, a small date row and a black Open task button, with a pale nine-dot grip at the right edge.
behaves: Pressing a grip lifts its card with a soft shadow and shrinks the grip slightly; the card follows the pointer while the rows below slide to close the gap. Releasing drops it into the new position and the list settles with a spring.
customise: No props: the three tasks, their dates and links are written into the state in the file, and the grip, shadow spring and max width live in the source.
weight: light: Three DOM rows and a spring that only runs while a card is dragged.
